chapitres.competenceChapitre: The learner can use language to talk about national integration, diversity acceptance, and cross-national celebrations.

lessons.titreLesson: Interacting with Peers from Other Tribes and Cultures

objectifsLesson.description: Read short texts and illustrated stories about interacting with peers from other cultures.
Contrast vowel and consonant sounds.
Use adjuncts: 'while', 'for', 'neither... nor', 'either... or', 'only', 'also', 'never', 'ever', 'although'.
Write short narrative and expository paragraphs on interacting with peers.

lessons.titreLesson: Socialising with Friends and Neighbours of Other Religions

objectifsLesson.description: Read descriptive and narrative texts about socialising with neighbours of other religions.
Identify and use ellipsis (e.g., 'Ndongo loves Ngum, and so does Ekwalla').
Write short stories and dialogues about socialising with people of other religions.
Read poems and newspaper briefs on tolerating and accepting others.
Give and accept/reject suggestions and plans related to tolerance.
Write tips, dialogues, and song lyrics on tolerating others.
Read basic descriptions with national symbols about cross-national celebrations.
Exchange information through dialogues and conversations about national celebrations.
Write reports, commentaries, and interviews on taking part in celebrations.

chapitres.competenceChapitre: The learner can use language to talk about consumption habits, social life, and leisure activities.

objectifsLesson.description: Read short texts and advertisements about going to a restaurant.
Produce correct word stress and sentence stress.
Use simple expressions of purpose.
Write short narrative and expository paragraphs about going to a restaurant.
Read brochures and flyers related to inquiring about accommodation.
Use gerunds.
Write short dialogues, conversations, and sketches about accommodation.
Read advertisements and flyers related to finding best buys.
Recycle comparatives.
Write dialogues, advertisements, and brochures about best buys.
Read health tips and forms related to leisure activities.
Construct complex sentences using coordination and subordination.
Write short stories, poems, and health tips about leisure activities.

chapitres.competenceChapitre: The learner can use language to talk about climate change, global warming, and maintaining hygiene and sanitation.

objectifsLesson.description: Read simple texts and poems about environmental issues.
Show mastery of intonation and stress patterns.
Share personal experiences and sing songs about environmental issues.
Read simple texts with pictures and instructions on weather conditions.
Use relative clauses.
Write simple texts and poems providing information about weather conditions.

lessons.titreLesson: Finding out about Climate Change and Global Warming

objectifsLesson.description: Read charts, diagrams, and brochures on climate change.
Use direct and indirect speech.
Complete dialogues and paragraphs about climate change.
Read descriptions and articles about garbage collection.
Use the first and second conditionals.
Write short stories and brochures about recycling services.

chapitres.competenceChapitre: The learner can use language to talk about the quest for excellence, gender issues, and democracy.

lessons.titreLesson: Volunteering in Gender Equality Promotion Activities

objectifsLesson.description: Read simple texts and dialogues about volunteering in gender equality activities.
Recycle active and passive voice.
Write descriptive and expository paragraphs on volunteering.

lessons.titreLesson: Participating in Training Activities on Democracy

objectifsLesson.description: Read charters and descriptive paragraphs on democracy.
Use question tags.
Fill out forms and write questions and answers about democracy.

lessons.titreLesson: Taking Part in Polls and Surveys

objectifsLesson.description: Read short forms, maps, and reports related to taking part in polls.
Identify word order.
Write friendly letters and short reports about polls and surveys.

lessons.titreLesson: Campaigning and Voting for School Prefects

objectifsLesson.description: Read notices, campaign speeches, and song lyrics about voting.
Use phrasal verbs.
Write song lyrics, speeches, and short dialogues about campaigning.

chapitres.competenceChapitre: The learner can use language to explore the utilities of modern technology and digital devices.

objectifsLesson.description: Read short texts and instructions about subscribing to service packages.
Use phrasal verbs related to ICTs.
Express preferences and requests about subscribing to services.
Read letters of complaint and interviews about service quality.
Use general revision of grammar.
Write emails, letters, and tweets complaining about service quality.

lessons.titreLesson: Facing Difficulties with Android Phones, iPhone, iPad

objectifsLesson.description: Read basic descriptions with symbols and diagrams about difficulties with gadgets.
Use general revision of speech work.
Write tips, instructions, and brochures about difficulties with gadgets.

lessons.titreLesson: Relaxing with Video Games and Computers

objectifsLesson.description: Read simple instructions and stories about relaxing with video games.
Use general revision of vocabulary related to ICTs.
Write short stories and paragraphs about video games and computers.
